name: Baheti Recycling Industries Ltd.
summary: Baheti Recycling Industries Ltd. is an India-based company primarily engaged in the aluminum recycling industry, focusing on processing aluminum-based metal scrap. The company manufactures a range of products, including aluminum alloys in the form of ingots, and aluminum de-ox alloys available as cubes, ingots, shots, and notch bars. Its product line also includes aluminum wire rod, cored wire, and ferro titanium. Baheti Recycling Industries serves diverse industries such as automobiles, construction, electrical transmission applications, and food packaging. Its aluminum de-ox alloys are utilized as deoxidizers in steel manufacturing units. The company operates within the Castings & Forging segment and caters to both domestic and international markets, including the Indian Steel Industry, South Korea, and the Middle East.
